mapper.sql: id, title, notice_type as noticeType, notice_type as type, target_role as targetRole, target_role as target, priority, source_module as sourceModule, source_id as sourceId, business_type as businessType, content, publish_status as publishStatus, publish_status as status, publish_time as publishTime, withdrawn_at as withdrawnAt, archived_at as archivedAt, deleted, deleted_at as deletedAt, created_by as createdBy, case when publish_status = '已发布' then 'success' when publish_status = '定时发布' then 'primary' when publish_status = '已撤回' then 'warning' when publish_status = '已归档' then 'info' when publish_status = '草稿' then 'info' else 'warning' end as tagType, coalesce(stats.recipient_count, 0) as recipientCount, coalesce(stats.read_count, 0) as readCount, greatest(coalesce(stats.recipient_count, 0) - coalesce(stats.read_count, 0), 0) as unreadCount, created_at as createdAt, updated_at as updatedAt
mapper.select:
select
from notice n left join ( select notice_id, count(1) as recipient_count, sum(case when read_status = '已读' then 1 else 0 end) as read_count from notice_recipient where deleted = 0 group by notice_id ) stats on stats.notice_id = n.id where coalesce(n.deleted, 0) = 0 order by coalesce(publish_time, created_at) desc, id desc

select
from notice n left join ( select notice_id, count(1) as recipient_count, sum(case when read_status = '已读' then 1 else 0 end) as read_count from notice_recipient where deleted = 0 group by notice_id ) stats on stats.notice_id = n.id where n.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into notice ( title, notice_type, target_role, priority, source_module, source_id, business_type, content, publish_status, publish_time, created_by ) values ( #{title}, coalesce(nullif(#{noticeType}, ''), nullif(#{type}, ''), '系统提醒'), coalesce(nullif(#{targetRole}, ''), nullif(#{target}, ''), 'labAdmin'), coalesce(nullif(#{priority}, ''), '普通'), nullif(#{sourceModule}, ''), nullif(#{sourceId}, ''), nullif(#{businessType}, ''), #{content}, coalesce(nullif(#{publishStatus}, ''), nullif(#{status}, ''), '草稿'), #{publishTime}, #{createdBy} )
mapper.update: update notice set title = #{notice.title}, notice_type = coalesce(nullif(#{notice.noticeType}, ''), nullif(#{notice.type}, ''), notice_type), target_role = coalesce(nullif(#{notice.targetRole}, ''), nullif(#{notice.target}, ''), target_role), priority = coalesce(nullif(#{notice.priority}, ''), priority), source_module = nullif(#{notice.sourceModule}, ''), source_id = nullif(#{notice.sourceId}, ''), business_type = nullif(#{notice.businessType}, ''), content = #{notice.content}, publish_status = coalesce(nullif(#{notice.publishStatus}, ''), nullif(#{notice.status}, ''), publish_status), publish_time = coalesce(#{notice.publishTime}, publish_time), updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update notice set publish_status = '已发布', publish_time = coalesce(publish_time, now()), withdrawn_at = null, archived_at = null, deleted = 0, deleted_at = null, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}

update notice set publish_status = #{status}, withdrawn_at = case when #{status} = '已撤回' then now() else withdrawn_at end, archived_at = case when #{status} = '已归档' then now() else archived_at end, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update notice set publish_status = '已归档', archived_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update notice set deleted = 1, deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert ignore into notice_recipient ( notice_id, user_id, username, real_name, role_code ) select #{noticeId}, u.id, u.username, u.real_name, r.role_code from sys_user u left join user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.id left join role r on r.id = ur.role_id where coalesce(u.status, 1) = 1 and ( #{targetRole} = 'all' or r.role_code = #{targetRole} )

insert ignore into notice_recipient ( notice_id, user_id, username, real_name, role_code ) select n.id, u.id, u.username, u.real_name, r.role_code from notice n join sys_user u on u.id = #{userId} left join user_role ur on ur.user_id = u.id left join role r on r.id = ur.role_id where coalesce(n.deleted, 0) = 0 and n.publish_status = '已发布' and coalesce(u.status, 1) = 1 and ( n.target_role in ('all', '全部用户') or n.target_role = #{roleCode} or ( #{roleCode} = 'labAdmin' and n.target_role in ('实验室管理员', '实验室管理员端') ) or ( #{roleCode} = 'systemAdmin' and n.target_role in ('系统管理员', '平台管理员') ) or ( #{roleCode} = 'teacher' and n.target_role in ('教师', '任课教师', '业务使用方') ) or ( #{roleCode} = 'maintenance' and n.target_role in ('维修人员', '运维人员') ) )
mapper.sql: nr.id, nr.notice_id as noticeId, nr.user_id as userId, nr.username, nr.real_name as realName, nr.role_code as roleCode, nr.read_status as readStatus, nr.read_time as readTime, nr.archived, nr.archived_at as archivedAt, nr.deleted, nr.deleted_at as deletedAt, nr.created_at as createdAt, nr.updated_at as updatedAt, n.title, n.notice_type as noticeType, n.notice_type as type, n.target_role as targetRole, n.target_role as target, n.priority, n.source_module as sourceModule, n.source_id as sourceId, n.business_type as businessType, n.content, n.publish_status as publishStatus, n.publish_status as status, n.publish_time as publishTime, case when nr.read_status = '未读' then 'warning' when n.publish_status = '已发布' then 'success' else 'info' end as tagType
mapper.select:
select
from notice_recipient nr join notice n on n.id = nr.notice_id where nr.notice_id = #{noticeId} order by nr.read_status desc, nr.id desc

select
from notice_recipient nr join notice n on n.id = nr.notice_id where nr.user_id = #{userId} and coalesce(n.deleted, 0) = 0 and coalesce(nr.deleted, 0) = 0 and coalesce(nr.archived, 0) = 0 and n.publish_status = '已发布'
and nr.read_status = #{readStatus}
order by n.publish_time desc, nr.id desc
mapper.update: update notice_recipient set read_status = '已读', read_time = coalesce(read_time, now()), updated_at = now() where notice_id = #{noticeId} and user_id = #{userId} and deleted = 0
mapper.select: select (select count(1) from notice where coalesce(deleted, 0) = 0) as total, (select count(1) from notice where coalesce(deleted, 0) = 0 and publish_status = '草稿') as draftCount, (select count(1) from notice where coalesce(deleted, 0) = 0 and publish_status = '已发布') as publishedCount, (select count(1) from notice where coalesce(deleted, 0) = 0 and publish_status = '已撤回') as withdrawnCount, (select count(1) from notice where coalesce(deleted, 0) = 0 and publish_status = '已归档') as archivedCount, (select count(1) from notice_recipient where deleted = 0) as deliveryCount, (select count(1) from notice_recipient where deleted = 0 and read_status = '已读') as readCount, (select count(1) from notice_recipient where deleted = 0 and read_status = '未读') as unreadCount, (select count(1) from notice_recipient where deleted = 0 and user_id = #{userId}) as myTotal, (select count(1) from notice_recipient where deleted = 0 and user_id = #{userId} and read_status = '未读') as myUnread, (select count(1) from notice_recipient where deleted = 0 and user_id = #{userId} and read_status = '已读') as myRead
select id, name, stock, unit, warn_threshold as warnThreshold, status from consumable_inventory where stock <= warn_threshold order by stock asc, id desc limit 20

select r.id, r.applicant_name as applicantName, l.lab_name as labName, r.reservation_date as reservationDate, r.time_range as timeRange, r.status from lab_reservation r left join lab l on l.id = r.lab_id where r.status in ('待审核', '冲突') order by r.created_at desc limit 20

select r.id, r.order_no as ticket, r.fault_type as faultType, r.priority_level as priority, r.status, l.lab_name as labName, d.device_name as deviceName from repair_order r left join lab l on l.id = r.lab_id left join device d on d.id = r.device_id where r.status not in ('已完成', '已关闭', '已取消') order by r.id desc limit 20
